series: IDC FutureScape: Worldwide IT Industry Predictions; IDC FutureScape: Worldwide CIO Agenda Predictions

futurescapes.name: Worldwide IT Industry
futurescapes.title: IDC FutureScape: Worldwide IT Industry 2020 Predictions
futurescapes.note: Read from IDC's webinar deck (Frank Gens, October 29, 2019), hosted by a third party. IDC document number not found; the report's table of contents was not located. Quotes are the full slide sentences; IDC's hashtag labels are kept in idc_label.

futurescapes.name: Worldwide CIO Agenda
futurescapes.title: IDC FutureScape: Worldwide CIO Agenda 2020 Predictions
futurescapes.note: Table of contents read from an Internet Archive copy.

entries.quote: By 2023, over 50% of all ICT spending will be directly for digital transformation and innovation (up from 27% in 2018), growing at 17% CAGR (vs. -3.5% for the rest of ICT)
entries.subject: Digital transformation share of ICT spending
entries.metric: share of ICT spending directly for digital transformation and innovation

entries.quote: By 2022, 70% of enterprises will integrate cloud management — across their public and private clouds — by deploying unified hybrid/multicloud management technologies, tools, and processes
entries.subject: Hybrid/multicloud management
entries.metric: share of enterprises integrating cloud management across public and private clouds

entries.quote: By 2023, over 50% of new enterprise IT infrastructure deployed will be at the edge rather than corporate datacenters, up from less than 10% today; by 2024, the number of apps at the edge will increase 800%
entries.subject: Edge infrastructure
entries.metric: share of new enterprise IT infrastructure deployed at the edge
entries.note: Also: by 2024, apps at the edge increase 800%.

entries.quote: By 2025, nearly two-thirds of enterprises will be prolific software producers with code deployed daily, over 90% of new apps cloud native, 80% of code externally sourced, and 1.6 times more developers
entries.subject: Enterprises as software producers
entries.metric: share of enterprises that are prolific software producers

entries.quote: By 2023, over 500 million digital apps and services will be developed and deployed using cloud-native approaches, most of those targeted at industry-specific digital transformation use cases
entries.subject: Cloud-native apps
entries.metric: number of digital apps and services developed with cloud-native approaches

entries.quote: By 2025, at least 90% of new enterprise apps will embed AI; by 2024, over 50% of user interface interactions will use AI-enabled computer vision, speech, natural language processing, and AR/VR
entries.subject: AI in enterprise apps
entries.metric: share of new enterprise apps embedding AI
entries.note: Also: by 2024, over 50% of UI interactions use AI-enabled vision, speech, NLP, AR/VR.

entries.quote: By 2023, 50% of the G2000 will name a Chief Trust Officer, who
entries.subject: Chief Trust Officer
entries.metric: share of G2000 naming a Chief Trust Officer

entries.quote: By 2023, 60% of the G2000 will have a digital developer ecosystem with thousands of developers; half of those enterprises will drive 20%+ of digital revenue through their digital ecosystem/platform
entries.subject: Enterprise developer ecosystems
entries.metric: share of G2000 with a digital developer ecosystem

entries.quote: By 2025, 20% of revenue growth will be from "white space" offerings that
entries.subject: Cross-industry offerings
entries.metric: share of revenue growth from white-space cross-industry offerings

entries.quote: By 2023, the Top 5 public cloud megaplatforms will consolidate at least 75% of market share; the Top 10 pureplay SaaS vendors will generate an average of near 20% revenue from expanding PaaS services
entries.subject: Cloud megaplatform concentration
entries.metric: market share of the top 5 public cloud megaplatforms

entries.quote: By 2024, the IT Strategy for 80% of Digitally Advanced Organizations Will Evolve to a Broad, Flexible, Self-Service Mashup of Digital Tools to Replace the "Walled Garden" IT-as-an-Enabler Model
entries.subject: Self-service digital tool mashup
entries.metric: share of digitally advanced organizations whose IT strategy becomes a self-service mashup of digital tools

entries.quote: By 2023, 65% of CIOs Will Be Entrepreneurial Leaders Who Evolve Their Organizations into Centers of Excellence That Engineer Enterprisewide Collaboration and Innovation
entries.subject: Entrepreneurial CIOs
entries.metric: share of CIOs who are entrepreneurial leaders

entries.quote: Driven Both by Escalating Cyberthreats and Needed New Functionality, 65% of Enterprises Will Aggressively Modernize Legacy Systems with Extensive New Technology Platform Investments Through 2023
entries.subject: Legacy modernization
entries.metric: share of enterprises aggressively modernizing legacy systems

entries.quote: By 2023, as a Pillar of Their IT Multicloud Approach, 70% of IT Organizations Will Implement a Strategic Container/Abstraction/API Playbook to Enhance Application Portability and Hosting Flexibility
entries.subject: Container/API playbook
entries.metric: share of IT organizations implementing a container/abstraction/API playbook

entries.quote: By 2022, 70% of IT Organizations Will Have Transitioned from Builders and Operators to Designers and Integrators of Digital Solutions That Come to Define Every Product, Service, or Process
entries.subject: IT as designer and integrator
entries.metric: share of IT organizations transitioned to designers and integrators

entries.quote: Through 2023, 80% of IT Organizations Will Accelerate Software Development to Enable Them to Deploy at Least Weekly Code Updates/Revisions and Business Value Delivery
entries.subject: Weekly code deployment
entries.metric: share of IT organizations deploying at least weekly code updates

entries.quote: By 2022, as Innovation Becomes Synonymous with Disruption, 40% of CIOs Will Co-Lead Innovation, Articulating Digital Visions and Infusing Intelligence Enterprisewide
entries.subject: CIO co-leading innovation
entries.metric: share of CIOs co-leading innovation

entries.quote: Through 2022, Deployment of Artificial Intelligence to Augment, Streamline, and Accelerate IT Operations Will Be a Principal IT Transformation Initiative for 60% of Enterprise IT Organizations
entries.subject: AI for IT operations
entries.metric: share of enterprise IT organizations with AI for IT operations as principal initiative

entries.quote: Through 2024, 75% of CIOs Will Reshape All IT Resources, Including Budgets, Assets, and Talent, to Support Real-Time Resource Allocation and Enterprise Agility, Dramatically Reducing Fixed Costs
entries.subject: Real-time IT resource allocation
entries.metric: share of CIOs reshaping IT resources for real-time allocation

entries.quote: By 2023, Driven by the Mandate to Deliver Engaging, Agile, Continuous Learning-Fueled Workspaces, 60% of CIOs Will Implement Formal Employee Experience Programs
entries.subject: Employee experience programs
entries.metric: share of CIOs implementing formal employee experience programs
